97	class TBLite(ase.calculators.calculator.Calculator):
98	    r"""
99	    ASE calculator for using xTB Hamiltonians from the tblite library.
100	    Supported properties by this calculator are:
101	
102	    - *energy* (*free_energy*): The total energy of the system (in eV)
103	    - *energies*: The atom-partitioned energy of the system (in eV)
104	    - *forces*: The derivative of the energy with respect to the atomic positions (in eV/Ang)
105	    - *stress*: The derivative of the energy with respect to cell deformations (PBC only, in eV/Ang³)
106	    - *dipole*: The dipole moment of the system (in Debye)
107	    - *charges*: Mulliken charges of the system (in e)
108	
109	    Supported keywords are
110	
111	    ======================== ================= ====================================================
112	     Keyword                  Default           Description
113	    ======================== ================= ====================================================
114	     method                   "GFN2-xTB"        Underlying method for energy and forces
115	     charge                   None              Total charge of the system
116	     multiplicity             None              Total multiplicity of the system
117	     accuracy                 1.0               Numerical accuracy of the calculation
118	     electronic_temperature   300.0             Electronic temperatur in Kelvin
119	     max_iterations           250               Iterations for self-consistent evaluation
120	     initial_guess            "sad"             Initial guess for wavefunction (sad, eeq, or eeqbc)
121	     mixer_damping            0.4               Damping parameter for self-consistent mixer
122	     electric_field           None              Uniform electric field vector (in V/A)
123	     spin_polarization        None              Spin polarization (scaling factor)
124	     solvation                None              Solvation model to use (see below for details)
125	     cache_api                True              Reuse generate API objects (recommended)
126	     verbosity                1                 Set verbosity of printout
127	     xtb_config               None              Additional configuration for the API calculator (dict)
128	    ======================== ================= ====================================================
129	
130	    Solvation models are supported by passing a tuple to the *solvation* keyword.
131	    The first element of the tuple is the name of the solvation model, the following
132	    arguments are passed to initialize the solvation model.
133	
134	    ================== ====================================================
135	     Solvation model    Arguments
136	    ================== ====================================================
137	     "alpb"             Solvent name (str), solution state (optional)
138	     "gbsa"             Solvent name (str), solution state (optional)
139	     "cosmo"            Epsilon (float) / Solvent name (str)
140	     "cpcm"             Epsilon (float) / Solvent name (str)
141	     "pcm"              Epsilon (float) / Solvent name (str)
142	     "gbe"              Epsilon (float), Born kernel
143	     "gb"               Epsilon (float), Born kernel
144	    ================== ====================================================
145	
146	    Example
147	    -------
148	
149	    An ASE calculator can be constructed by using the *TBLite* class provided
150	    by the *tblite.ase* module.
151	    For example to perform a single point calculation for a CO\ :sub:`2`
152	    crystal use
153	
154	    >>> from tblite.ase import TBLite
155	    >>> from ase.atoms import Atoms
156	    >>> import numpy as np
157	    >>> atoms = Atoms(
158	    ...     symbols="C4O8",
159	    ...     positions=np.array(
160	    ...         [
161	    ...             [0.9441259872, 0.9437851680, 0.9543505632],
162	    ...             [3.7179966528, 0.9556570368, 3.7316862240],
163	    ...             [3.7159517376, 3.7149292800, 0.9692330016],
164	    ...             [0.9529872864, 3.7220864832, 3.7296981120],
165	    ...             [1.6213905408, 1.6190616096, 1.6313879040],
166	    ...             [0.2656685664, 0.2694175776, 0.2776540416],
167	    ...             [4.3914553920, 1.6346256864, 3.0545920000],
168	    ...             [3.0440834880, 0.2764611744, 4.4080419264],
169	    ...             [4.3910577696, 3.0416409504, 0.2881058304],
170	    ...             [3.0399936576, 4.3879335936, 1.6497353376],
171	    ...             [0.2741322432, 4.4003734944, 3.0573754368],
172	    ...             [1.6312174944, 3.0434586528, 4.4023048032],
173	    ...         ]
174	    ...     ),
175	    ...     cell=np.array([5.68032, 5.68032, 5.68032]),
176	    ...     pbc=np.array([True, True, True]),
177	    ... )
178	    >>> atoms.calc = TBLite(method="GFN1-xTB", verbosity=0)
179	    >>> atoms.get_potential_energy()  # result in eV
180	    -1257.0943962462964
181	
182	    The resulting calculator can be used like most ASE calculator, *e.g.* for optimizing geometries.
183	    """
184	
185	    implemented_properties = [
186	        "energy",
187	        "energies",
188	        "forces",
189	        "charges",
190	        "dipole",
191	        "stress",
192	    ]
193	
194	    default_parameters = {
195	        "method": "GFN2-xTB",
196	        "charge": None,
197	        "multiplicity": None,
198	        "accuracy": 1.0,
199	        "guess": "sad",
200	        "max_iterations": 250,
201	        "mixer_damping": 0.4,
202	        "electric_field": None,
203	        "spin_polarization": None,
204	        "solvation": None,
205	        "electronic_temperature": 300.0,
206	        "cache_api": True,
207	        "verbosity": 1,
208	        "xtb_config": None,
209	    }
210	
211	    _res = None
212	    _xtb = None
213	
214	    def __init__(
215	        self,
216	        atoms: Optional[Atoms] = None,
217	        **kwargs,
218	    ):
219	        """
220	        Construct the TBLite base calculator object.
221	        """
222	
223	        ase.calculators.calculator.Calculator.__init__(self, atoms=atoms, **kwargs)
224	
225	    def set(self, **kwargs) -> dict:
226	        """
227	        Set new parameters to TBLite. Will automatically reconstruct the underlying
228	        model in case critical parameters change.
229	
230	        Example
231	        -------
232	        >>> from ase.build import molecule
233	        >>> from tblite.ase import TBLite
234	        >>> atoms = molecule("H2O")
235	        >>> atoms.calc = TBLite(method="GFN2-xTB")
236	        >>> atoms.get_potential_energy()
237	        -137.96777625229421
238	        >>> atoms.calc.set(method="GFN1-xTB")
239	        {'method': 'GFN1-xTB'}
240	        >>> atoms.get_potential_energy()
241	        -156.9675057724589
242	        """
243	
244	        _update_parameters(kwargs)
245	
246	        changed_parameters = ase.calculators.calculator.Calculator.set(self, **kwargs)
247	
248	        # Always reset the calculation if parameters change
249	        if changed_parameters:
250	            self.reset()
251	
252	        # If the method is changed, invalidate the cached calculator as well
253	        if (
254	            "method" in changed_parameters
255	            or "electric_field" in changed_parameters
256	            or "spin_polarization" in changed_parameters
257	            or "solvation" in changed_parameters
258	            or "xtb_config" in changed_parameters
259	        ):
260	            self._xtb = None
261	            self._res = None
262	
263	        # Minor changes can be updated in the API calculator directly
264	        if self._xtb is not None:
265	            if "accuracy" in changed_parameters:
266	                self._xtb.set("accuracy", self.parameters.accuracy)
267	
268	            if "electronic_temperature" in changed_parameters:
269	                self._xtb.set(
270	                    "temperature",
271	                    self.parameters.electronic_temperature * kB / Hartree,
272	                )
273	
274	            if "max_iterations" in changed_parameters:
275	                self._xtb.set("max-iter", self.parameters.max_iterations)
276	
277	            if "initial_guess" in changed_parameters:
278	                self._xtb.set(
279	                    "guess", {"sad": 0, "eeq": 1, "eeqbc": 2}[self.parameters.guess]
280	                )
281	
282	            if "mixer_damping" in changed_parameters:
283	                self._xtb.set("mixer-damping", self.parameters.mixer_damping)
284	
285	            if (
286	                "charge" in changed_parameters or "multiplicity" in changed_parameters
287	            ) and self.atoms is not None:
288	                self._xtb.update(
289	                    charge=_get_charge(self.atoms, self.parameters),
290	                    uhf=_get_uhf(self.atoms, self.parameters),
291	                )
292	
293	        return changed_parameters
294	
295	    def reset(self) -> None:
296	        """
297	        Clear all information from old calculation. This will only remove the cached
298	        API objects in case the `cache_api` is set to False.
299	        """
300	        ase.calculators.calculator.Calculator.reset(self)
301	
302	        if not self.parameters.cache_api:
303	            self._xtb = None
304	            self._res = None
305	
306	    def _check_api_calculator(self, system_changes: List[str]) -> None:
307	        """Check state of API calculator and reset if necessary"""
308	
309	        # Changes in positions, cell, charges and magnetic moments can use a normal update
310	        _reset = system_changes.copy()
311	        for _change in system_changes:
312	            if _change in ("positions", "cell", "initial_charges", "initial_magmoms"):
313	                _reset.remove(_change)
314	
315	        # Invalidate cached calculator and results object
316	        if _reset:
317	            self._xtb = None
318	            self._res = None
319	        else:
320	            if system_changes and self._xtb is not None:
321	                try:
322	                    _cell = self.atoms.cell
323	                    self._xtb.update(
324	                        positions=self.atoms.positions / Bohr,
325	                        lattice=_cell / Bohr,
326	                        charge=_get_charge(self.atoms, self.parameters),
327	                        uhf=_get_uhf(self.atoms, self.parameters),
328	                    )
329	                # An exception in this part means the geometry is bad,
330	                # still we will give a complete reset a try as well
331	                except RuntimeError:
332	                    self._xtb = None
333	                    self._res = None
334	
335	    def calculate(
336	        self,
337	        atoms: Optional[Atoms] = None,
338	        properties: Optional[List[str]] = None,
339	        system_changes: List[str] = ase.calculators.calculator.all_changes,
340	    ) -> None:
341	        """
342	        Perform actual calculation by calling the TBLite API
343	
344	        Example
345	        -------
346	
347	        >>> from ase.build import molecule
348	        >>> from tblite.ase import TBLite
349	        >>> calc = TBLite(method="GFN2-xTB")
350	        >>> calc.calculate(molecule("H2O"))
351	        >>> calc.get_potential_energy()
352	        -137.96777625229421
353	        >>> calc.calculate(molecule("CH4"))
354	        >>> calc.get_potential_energy()
355	        -113.60956621093894
356	
357	        Raises
358	        ------
359	        ase.calculators.calculator.InputError
360	            on invalid input passed to the interface module
361	
362	        ase.calculators.calculator.CalculationFailed
363	            in case of an `RuntimeError` in the library
364	        """
365	
366	        if not properties:
367	            properties = ["energy"]
368	        ase.calculators.calculator.Calculator.calculate(
369	            self, atoms, properties, system_changes
370	        )
371	
372	        self._check_api_calculator(system_changes)
373	
374	        if self._xtb is None:
375	            self._xtb = _create_api_calculator(self.atoms, self.parameters)
376	
377	        try:
378	            self._res = self._xtb.singlepoint(self._res)
379	        except RuntimeError as e:
380	            raise ase.calculators.calculator.CalculationFailed(str(e)) from e
381	
382	        # These properties are garanteed to exist for all implemented calculators
383	        self.results["energy"] = self._res["energy"] * Hartree
384	        self.results["energies"] = self._res["energies"] * Hartree
385	        self.results["free_energy"] = self.results["energy"]
386	        self.results["forces"] = -self._res["gradient"] * Hartree / Bohr
387	        self.results["charges"] = self._res["charges"]
388	        self.results["dipole"] = self._res["dipole"] * Bohr
389	        self.results["bond-orders"] = self._res["bond-orders"]
390	        # stress tensor is only returned for periodic systems
391	        if self.atoms.pbc.any():
392	            _stress = self._res["virial"] * Hartree / self.atoms.get_volume()
393	            self.results["stress"] = _stress.flat[[0, 4, 8, 5, 2, 1]]
394	
395	
396	def _create_api_calculator(
397	    atoms: ase.Atoms,
398	    parameters: ase.calculators.calculator.Parameters,
399	) -> Calculator:
400	    """Create a new API calculator object"""
401	
402	    try:
403	        _cell = atoms.cell
404	        _periodic = atoms.pbc
405	        _charge = _get_charge(atoms, parameters)
406	        _uhf = _get_uhf(atoms, parameters)
407	
408	        calc = Calculator(
409	            parameters.method,
410	            atoms.numbers,
411	            atoms.positions / Bohr,
412	            _charge,
413	            _uhf,
414	            _cell / Bohr,
415	            _periodic,
416	            xtb_config=parameters.xtb_config,
417	        )
418	        calc.set("accuracy", parameters.accuracy)
419	        calc.set(
420	            "temperature",
421	            parameters.electronic_temperature * kB / Hartree,
422	        )
423	        calc.set("max-iter", parameters.max_iterations)
424	        calc.set("guess", {"sad": 0, "eeq": 1, "eeqbc": 2}[parameters.guess])
425	        calc.set("mixer-damping", parameters.mixer_damping)
426	        calc.set("verbosity", parameters.verbosity)
427	        if parameters.electric_field is not None:
428	            calc.add(
429	                "electric-field",
430	                parameters.electric_field * Bohr / Hartree,
431	            )
432	        if parameters.spin_polarization is not None:
433	            calc.add("spin-polarization", parameters.spin_polarization)
434	        if parameters.solvation is not None:
435	            solvation_model, *solvation_args = parameters.solvation
436	            if isinstance(solvation_args, (tuple, list)):
437	                calc.add(f"{solvation_model}-solvation", *solvation_args)
438	            else:
439	                calc.add(f"{solvation_model}-solvation", solvation_args)
440	
441	    except RuntimeError as e:
442	        raise ase.calculators.calculator.InputError(str(e)) from e
443	
444	    return calc
445	
446	
447	def _get_charge(
448	    atoms: ase.Atoms, parameters: ase.calculators.calculator.Parameters
449	) -> int:
450	    """
451	    Get the total charge of the system.
452	    If no charge is provided, the total charge of the system is calculated
453	    by summing the initial charges of all atoms.
454	    """
455	    return (
456	        atoms.get_initial_charges().sum()
457	        if parameters.charge is None
458	        else parameters.charge
459	    )
460	
461	
462	def _get_uhf(
463	    atoms: ase.Atoms, parameters: ase.calculators.calculator.Parameters
464	) -> int:
465	    """
466	    Get the number of unpaired electrons.
467	    If no multiplicity is provided, the number of unpaired electrons
468	    is calculated by summing the initial magnetic moments of all atoms.
469	    """
470	    return (
471	        int(atoms.get_initial_magnetic_moments().sum().round())
472	        if parameters.multiplicity is None
473	        else parameters.multiplicity - 1
474	    )
475	
476	
477	def _update_parameters(kwargs: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
478	    """
479	    Update the parameters of the calculator with the provided keyword arguments.
480	    This function is used to update the parameters of the calculator
481	    when new values are provided.
482	    """
483	
484	    ddx_models = ("cosmo", "cpcm", "pcm")
485	
486	    for key in (
487	        "alpb",
488	        "gbsa",
489	        "cosmo",
490	        "cpcm",
491	        "pcm",
492	        "gbe",
493	        "gb",
494	    ):
495	        if f"{key}_solvation" in kwargs:
496	            value = kwargs.pop(f"{key}_solvation")
497	
498	            if key in ddx_models:
499	                value = ("ddX", value, key)
500	            elif isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
501	                value = (key, *value)
502	            else:
503	                value = (key, value)
504	
505	            if "solvation" in kwargs:
506	                raise ase.calculators.calculator.InputError(
507	                    "Multiple solvation models provided, can only use one"
508	                )
509	
510	            kwargs["solvation"] = value
511	
512	
513	if "tblite" not in ase.calculators.calculator.external_calculators:
514	    ase.calculators.calculator.register_calculator_class("tblite", TBLite)

245	   !> Molecular structure data
246	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
247	   !> Number of shells for each atom
248	   integer, intent(in) :: nshell(:)
249	   !> Index offset for each shell
250	   integer, intent(in) :: offset(:)
251	   !> Hubbard parameter parameter for each shell
252	   real(wp), intent(in) :: hubbard(:, :, :, :)
253	   !> Exponent of Coulomb kernel

258	   integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, ii, jj, ish, jsh
259	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, r1g, gam, tmp

261	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
262	   !$omp shared(amat, mol, nshell, offset, hubbard, gexp) &
263	   !$omp private(iat, izp, ii, ish, jat, jzp, jj, jsh, gam, vec, r1, r1g, tmp)
264	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
265	      izp = mol%id(iat)
266	      ii = offset(iat)
267	      do jat = 1, iat-1
268	         jzp = mol%id(jat)
269	         jj = offset(jat)
270	         vec = mol%xyz(:, jat) - mol%xyz(:, iat)
271	         r1 = norm2(vec)
272	         r1g = r1**gexp
273	         do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
274	            do jsh = 1, nshell(jat)
275	               gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, jzp, izp)
276	               tmp = 1.0_wp/(r1g + gam**(-gexp))**(1.0_wp/gexp)
277	               amat(jj+jsh, ii+ish) = amat(jj+jsh, ii+ish) + tmp
278	               amat(ii+ish, jj+jsh) = amat(ii+ish, jj+jsh) + tmp
279	            end do
280	         end do
281	      end do
282	      do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
283	         do jsh = 1, ish-1
284	            gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, izp, izp)
285	            amat(ii+jsh, ii+ish) = amat(ii+jsh, ii+ish) + gam
286	            amat(ii+ish, ii+jsh) = amat(ii+ish, ii+jsh) + gam
287	         end do
288	         amat(ii+ish, ii+ish) = amat(ii+ish, ii+ish) + hubbard(ish, ish, izp, izp)
289	      end do
290	   end do

372	!> Calculate real space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
373	subroutine get_amat_dir_3d(rij, gam, gexp, rcut, alp, trans, amat)
374	   !> Distance between pair
375	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
376	   !> Hubbard parameter
377	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gam
378	   !> Exponent for interaction kernel
379	   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
380	   !> Long-range cutoff
381	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
382	   !> Convergence factor
383	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
384	   !> Translation vectors to consider
385	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
386	   !> Interaction matrix element
387	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat
388	
389	   integer :: itr
390	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fcut
391	
392	   amat = 0.0_wp
393	
394	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
395	      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
396	      r1 = norm2(vec)
397	      if (r1 < eps) cycle
398	      fcut = fsmooth(r1, rcut)
399	      tmp = fcut/(r1**gexp + gam**(-gexp))**(1.0_wp/gexp) + (1.0_wp-fcut)/r1 &
400	         & - erf(alp*r1)/r1
401	      amat = amat + tmp
402	   end do
403	
404	end subroutine get_amat_dir_3d

406	!> Calculate reciprocal space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
407	subroutine get_amat_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, qpc, trans, amat)
408	   !> Distance between pair
409	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
410	   !> Volume of cell
411	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
412	   !> Convergence factor
413	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
414	   !> Pseudo-quadrupole contribution
415	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qpc
416	   !> Translation vectors to consider
417	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
418	   !> Interaction matrix element
419	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat
420	
421	   integer :: itr
422	   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, gv, expk, cosk
423	
424	   amat = 0.0_wp
425	   fac = 4*pi/vol
426	
427	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
428	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
429	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
430	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
431	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
432	      expk = fac * exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
433	      cosk = cos(gv) * expk
434	      amat = amat + cosk
435	   end do

439	function fsmooth(r1, rcut) result(fcut)
440	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r1
441	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
442	   real(wp) :: fcut
443	
444	   real(wp), parameter :: offset = 1.0_wp
445	   real(wp), parameter :: c(*) = [-6.0_wp, 15.0_wp, -10.0_wp, 1.0_wp]
446	   real(wp) :: xrel
447	
448	   if (r1 < rcut - offset) then
449	      fcut = 1.0_wp
450	   else if (r1 > rcut) then
451	      fcut = 0.0_wp
452	   else
453	      xrel = (r1 - (rcut - offset)) / offset
454	      fcut = c(1)*xrel**5 + c(2)*xrel**4 + c(3)*xrel**3 + c(4)
455	   end if
456	end function fsmooth

458	function dsmooth(r1, rcut) result(dcut)
459	   real(wp), intent(in) :: r1
460	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
461	   real(wp) :: dcut
462	
463	   real(wp), parameter :: offset = 1.0_wp
464	   real(wp), parameter :: c(*) = [-6.0_wp, 15.0_wp, -10.0_wp, 1.0_wp]
465	   real(wp) :: xrel
466	
467	   if (r1 < rcut - offset .or. r1 > rcut) then
468	      dcut = 0.0_wp
469	   else
470	      xrel = (r1 - (rcut - offset)) / offset
471	      dcut = (5*c(1)*xrel**4 + 4*c(2)*xrel**3 + 3*c(3)*xrel**2) / offset
472	   end if

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path("/workspace/task")
SOURCE_ROOT = TASK_ROOT / "source"
BUILD_ROOT = TASK_ROOT / ".build"

library = next(c for c in sorted(BUILD_ROOT.glob("libtblite*.so*")) if c.is_file())
ctypes.CDLL(str(library), mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
ext = next(BUILD_ROOT.glob("python/tblite/_libtblite*.so"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT / "python"))
import tblite  # noqa: E402

tblite.__path__.insert(0, str(ext.parent))
from ase import Atoms  # noqa: E402
from tblite.ase import TBLite  # noqa: E402

symbols = "C2N2O4"
positions = np.asarray(
    [
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        [1.45, 0.0, 0.0],
        [2.50, 0.80, 0.0],
        [2.50, -0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, 0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, -0.80, 0.0],
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.20],
        [1.45, 0.0, 1.20],
    ]
)
cell = np.diag([8.0, 8.0, 8.0])


def energy(atoms, method):
    atoms.calc = TBLite(method=method, accuracy=0.1, verbosity=0)
    return float(atoms.get_potential_energy())


for method in ("GFN2-xTB", "GFN1-xTB"):
    unit = Atoms(symbols, positions=positions, cell=cell, pbc=True)
    e1 = energy(unit, method)
    sup2 = unit.repeat((2, 2, 2))
    e2 = energy(sup2, method) / 8
    print(f"{method}: unit={e1:.10f}  222/8={e2:.10f}  diff={e2 - e1:.6e}")

# Non-periodic for reference: large cell without pbc
np_unit = Atoms(symbols, positions=positions + 40.0, cell=np.diag([80.0, 80.0, 80.0]), pbc=False)
for method in ("GFN2-xTB",):
    e0 = energy(np_unit, method)
    print(f"non-periodic GFN2: {e0:.10f}")

195	!> Get anisotropic electrostatic energy
196	subroutine get_energy(self, mol, cache, wfn, energies)
197	   !> Instance of the multipole container
198	   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
199	   !> Molecular structure data
200	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
201	   !> Wavefunction data
202	   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
203	   !> Electrostatic energy
204	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)
205	   !> Reusable data container
206	   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache
207	
208	   real(wp), allocatable :: vs(:), vd(:, :), vq(:, :)
209	   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr
210	
211	   call view(cache, ptr)
212	
213	   allocate(vs(mol%nat), vd(3, mol%nat), vq(6, mol%nat))
214	
215	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%qat(:, 1), vd)
216	   call gemv(ptr%amat_dd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), vd, beta=1.0_wp, alpha=0.5_wp)
217	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qat(:, 1), vq)
218	
219	   energies(:) = energies + sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1) + sum(wfn%qpat(:, :, 1) * vq, 1)
220	
221	   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%dkernel, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), energies)
222	   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%qkernel, wfn%qpat(:, :, 1), energies)
223	end subroutine get_energy

225	!> Get anisotropic electrostatic energy
226	subroutine get_energy_aes(self, mol, cache, wfn, energies)
227	   !> Instance of the multipole container
228	   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
229	   !> Molecular structure data
230	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
231	   !> Wavefunction data
232	   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
233	   !> Electrostatic energy
234	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)
235	   !> Reusable data container
236	   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache
237	
238	   real(wp), allocatable :: vs(:), vd(:, :), vq(:, :),mur(:)
239	   real(wp), allocatable :: e01(:),e11(:),e02(:)
240	   real(wp), allocatable :: t1(:)
241	   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr
242	   integer :: i,j
243	
244	   call view(cache, ptr)
245	
246	   allocate(vs(mol%nat), vd(3, mol%nat), vq(6, mol%nat))
247	
248	   allocate(mur(mol%nat), source=0.0_wp)
249	   allocate(e01(mol%nat),e11(mol%nat),e02(mol%nat),source=0.0_wp)
250	   allocate(t1(mol%nat),source=0.0_wp)
251	
252	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%qat(:, 1), vd)
253	   do i = 1,3
254	      call gemv(ptr%amat_sd(i,:,:),wfn%dpat(i,:,1),mur,beta=1.0_wp, alpha=1.0_wp,trans="T")
255	   end do
256	
257	   e01 = (mur)*wfn%qat(:,1) + sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1)
258	
259	   vd = 0.0_wp
260	   call gemv(ptr%amat_dd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), vd, beta=1.0_wp, alpha=0.5_wp)
261	   e11 = sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1)
262	
263	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qat(:, 1), vq)
264	
265	   do i = 1,6
266	      call gemv(ptr%amat_sq(i,:,:),wfn%qpat(i,:,1),t1,beta=1.0_wp, alpha=1.0_wp,trans="T")
267	   end do
268	   e02 = t1*wfn%qat(:,1) + sum(wfn%qpat(:, :, 1) * vq, 1)
269	
270	   energies(:) = energies + 0.5_wp * e01 + e11 + 0.5_wp * e02
271	
272	end subroutine get_energy_aes

274	!> Get multipolar anisotropic exchange-correlation kernel
275	subroutine get_kernel_energy(mol, kernel, mpat, energies)
276	   !> Molecular structure data
277	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
278	   !> Multipole kernel
279	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kernel(:)
280	   !> Atomic multipole momemnt
281	   real(wp), intent(in) :: mpat(:, :)
282	   !> Electrostatic energy
283	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)
284	
285	   integer :: iat, izp
286	   real(wp) :: mpt(size(mpat, 1)), mpscale(size(mpat, 1))
287	
288	   mpscale(:) = 1
289	   if (size(mpat, 1) == 6) mpscale([2, 4, 5]) = 2
290	
291	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
292	      izp = mol%id(iat)
293	      mpt(:) = mpat(:, iat) * mpscale
294	      energies(iat) = energies(iat) + kernel(izp) * dot_product(mpt, mpat(:, iat))
295	   end do
296	end subroutine get_kernel_energy

299	!> Get anisotropic electrostatic potential
300	subroutine get_potential(self, mol, cache, wfn, pot)
301	   !> Instance of the multipole container
302	   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
303	   !> Molecular structure data
304	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
305	   !> Wavefunction data
306	   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
307	   !> Density dependent potential
308	   type(potential_type), intent(inout) :: pot
309	   !> Reusable data container
310	   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache
311	   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr
312	
313	   call view(cache, ptr)
314	
315	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%qat(:, 1), pot%vdp(:, :, 1), beta=1.0_wp)
316	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), pot%vat(:, 1), beta=1.0_wp, trans="T")
317	
318	   call gemv(ptr%amat_dd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), pot%vdp(:, :, 1), beta=1.0_wp)
319	
320	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qat(:, 1), pot%vqp(:, :, 1), beta=1.0_wp)
321	   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qpat(:, :, 1), pot%vat(:, 1), beta=1.0_wp, trans="T")
322	
323	   call get_kernel_potential(mol, self%dkernel, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), pot%vdp(:, :, 1))
324	   call get_kernel_potential(mol, self%qkernel, wfn%qpat(:, :, 1), pot%vqp(:, :, 1))
325	end subroutine get_potential

328	!> Get multipolar anisotropic potential contribution
329	subroutine get_kernel_potential(mol, kernel, mpat, vm)
330	   !> Molecular structure data
331	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
332	   !> Multipole kernel
333	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kernel(:)
334	   !> Atomic multipole momemnt
335	   real(wp), intent(in) :: mpat(:, :)
336	   !> Potential shoft on atomic multipole moment
337	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: vm(:, :)
338	
339	   integer :: iat, izp
340	   real(wp) :: mpscale(size(mpat, 1))
341	
342	   mpscale(:) = 1
343	   if (size(mpat, 1) == 6) mpscale([2, 4, 5]) = 2
344	
345	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
346	      izp = mol%id(iat)
347	      vm(:, iat) = vm(:, iat) + 2*kernel(izp) * mpat(:, iat) * mpscale
348	   end do

386	!> Calculate multipole damping radii
387	subroutine get_mrad(mol, shift, kexp, rmax, rad, valence_cn, cn, mrad, dmrdcn)
388	   !> Molecular structure data
389	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
390	   !> Shift for the generation of the multipolar damping radii
391	   real(wp), intent(in) :: shift
392	   !> Exponent for the generation of the multipolar damping radii
393	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kexp
394	   !> Maximum radius for the multipolar damping radii
395	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rmax
396	   !> Base radii for the multipolar damping radii
397	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
398	   !> Valence coordination number
399	   real(wp), intent(in) :: valence_cn(:)
400	   !> Coordination numbers for all atoms
401	   real(wp), intent(in) :: cn(:)
402	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
403	   real(wp), intent(out) :: mrad(:)
404	   !> Derivative of multipole damping radii with repect to the coordination numbers
405	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dmrdcn(:)
406	
407	   integer :: iat, izp
408	   real(wp) :: arg, t1, t2
409	
410	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
411	      izp = mol%id(iat)
412	      arg = cn(iat) - valence_cn(izp) - shift
413	      t1 = exp(-kexp*arg)
414	      t2 = (rmax - rad(izp)) / (1.0_wp + t1)
415	      mrad(iat) = rad(izp) + t2
416	      dmrdcn(iat) = -t2 * kexp * t1 / (1.0_wp + t1)
417	   end do
418	end subroutine get_mrad

460	   !> Instance of the multipole container

462	   !> Molecular structure data

469	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)

478	         & cache%wsc, cache%alpha, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
479	   else

485	!> Calculate the multipole interaction matrix for finite systems
486	subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
487	   !> Molecular structure data
488	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
489	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
490	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
491	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
492	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
493	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
494	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
495	   !> Interaction matrix for charges and dipoles
496	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
497	   !> Interaction matrix for dipoles and dipoles
498	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
499	   !> Interaction matrix for charges and quadrupoles
500	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)
501	
502	   integer :: iat, jat
503	   real(wp) :: r1, vec(3), g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc(6), rr
504	
505	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
506	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
507	   !$omp private(r1, vec, g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc, rr)
508	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
509	      do jat = 1, mol%nat
510	         if (iat == jat) cycle
511	         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
512	         r1 = norm2(vec)
513	         g1 = 1.0_wp / r1
514	         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
515	         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
516	
517	         rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat)) * g1
518	         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp3)
519	         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp5)
520	
521	         amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + vec * g3 * fdmp3
522	         amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) &
523	            & + unity * g3*fdmp5 - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * 3*g5*fdmp5
524	         tc(2) = 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
525	         tc(4) = 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
526	         tc(5) = 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
527	         tc(1) = vec(1)*vec(1)*g5*fdmp5
528	         tc(3) = vec(2)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
529	         tc(6) = vec(3)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
530	         amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + tc
531	      end do
532	   end do
533	end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d
534	
535	!> Evaluate multipole interaction matrix under 3D periodic boundary conditions
536	subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, wsc, alpha, &
537	      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
538	   !> Molecular structure data
539	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
540	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
541	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
542	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
543	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
544	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
545	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
546	   !> Wigner-Seitz cell images
547	   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
548	   !> Convergence parameter for Ewald sum
549	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
550	   !> Interation matrix for charges and dipoles
551	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
552	   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
553	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
554	   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
555	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)
556	
557	   integer :: iat, jat, img, k
558	   real(wp) :: vec(3), rr, wsw, vol
559	   real(wp) :: d_sd(3), d_dd(3, 3), d_sq(6), r_sd(3), r_dd(3, 3), r_sq(6)
560	   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)
561	
562	   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
563	   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
564	   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)
565	
566	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
567	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq) &
568	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, rad, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
569	   !$omp private(iat, jat, img, vec, rr, wsw, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
570	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
571	      do jat = 1, mol%nat
572	         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
573	         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
574	            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
575	
576	            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
577	            call get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, rtrans, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
578	            call get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq)
579	
580	            amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (d_sd + r_sd)
581	            amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) + wsw * (r_dd + d_dd)
582	            amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (r_sq + d_sq)
583	         end do
584	      end do
585	   end do
586	
587	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
588	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, vol, alpha) private(iat, rr, k)
589	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
590	      ! dipole-dipole selfenergy: -2/3·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) μ²(i)
591	      rr = -2.0_wp/3.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
592	      do k = 1, 3
593	         amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) = amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) + 2*rr
594	      end do
595	
596	      ! charge-quadrupole selfenergy: 4/9·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) q(i)Tr(θi)
597	      ! (no actual contribution since quadrupoles are traceless)
598	      rr = 4.0_wp/9.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
599	      amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) = amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) + rr
600	   end do
601	end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d

603	pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, trans, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
604	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
605	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
606	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
607	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
608	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
609	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
610	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)
611	
612	   integer :: itr
613	   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, expk, sink, cosk, gv
614	
615	   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
616	   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
617	   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
618	   fac = 4*pi/vol
619	
620	   amat_dd(1, 1) = fac/6.0_wp
621	   amat_dd(2, 2) = fac/6.0_wp
622	   amat_dd(3, 3) = fac/6.0_wp
623	   amat_sq([1, 3, 6]) = -fac/9.0_wp
624	
625	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
626	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
627	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
628	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
629	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
630	      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
631	      sink = sin(gv)*expk
632	      cosk = cos(gv)*expk
633	
634	      amat_sd(:) = amat_sd + 2*vec*sink
635	      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd + spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * cosk
636	      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*cosk
637	      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*cosk
638	      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*cosk
639	      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*cosk
640	      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*cosk
641	      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*cosk
642	   end do
643	
644	end subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d

646	pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, trans, &
647	      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
648	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
649	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
650	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
651	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
652	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
653	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
654	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
655	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
656	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)
657	
658	   integer :: itr
659	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, arg, arg2, alp2, e1, e2, erft, expt
660	
661	   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
662	   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
663	   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
664	   alp2 = alp*alp
665	
666	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
667	      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
668	      r1 = norm2(vec)
669	      if (r1 < eps) cycle
670	      g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
671	      g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
672	      g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
673	      fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp3)
674	      fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp5)
675	
676	      arg = r1*alp
677	      arg2 = arg*arg
678	      expt = exp(-arg2)/sqrtpi
679	      erft = -erf(arg)*g1
680	      e1 = g1*g1 * (erft + 2*expt*alp)
681	      e2 = g1*g1 * (e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)
682	
683	      tmp = fdmp3 * g3 + e1
684	      amat_sd = amat_sd + vec * tmp
685	      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd(:, :) + unity * (fdmp5*g3 + e1) &
686	         & - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * (3 * (g5*fdmp5 + e2))
687	      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
688	      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
689	      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
690	      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
691	      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
692	      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
693	   end do
694	
695	end subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d

729	subroutine get_multipole_gradient_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, qat, dpat, qpat, &
730	      & dEdr, gradient, sigma)
731	   !> Molecular structure data
732	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
733	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
734	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
735	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
736	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
737	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
738	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
739	   !> Atomic partial charges
740	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qat(:)
741	   !> Atomic dipole moments
742	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
743	   !> Atomic quadrupole moments
744	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
745	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii
746	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: dEdr(:)
747	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
748	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
749	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. strain deformations
750	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)
751	
752	   integer :: iat, jat
753	   real(wp) :: r1, r2, vec(3), rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG(3), dS(3, 3)
754	   real(wp) :: ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj
755	
756	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) reduction(+:dEdr, gradient, sigma) &
757	   !$omp shared(mol, kdmp3, kdmp5, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
758	   !$omp private(iat, jat, r1, r2, vec, rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG, dS, &
759	   !$omp& ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj)
760	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
761	      do jat = 1, iat - 1
762	         rr = 0.5_wp*(rad(iat)+rad(jat))
763	         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat)
764	         r1 = norm2(vec)
765	         r2 = r1 * r1
766	         g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
767	         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
768	         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
769	         g7 = g5 * g1 * g1
770	
771	         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
772	         ddmp3 = -3*g5*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3-1.0_wp)*g5
773	         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
774	         ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5-fdmp5)
775	
776	         dpiqj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, iat))*qat(jat)
777	         qidpj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, jat))*qat(iat)
778	         fddr = 3.0_wp*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
779	         dg(:) = - ddmp3*vec * (dpiqj - qidpj) &
780	            & + fdmp3*g3*(qat(iat)*dpat(:, jat) - qat(jat)*dpat(:, iat))
781	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dG, 2, 3) &
782	            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
783	
784	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
785	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
786	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dG
787	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dG
788	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + dS
789	
790	         dpidpj = dot_product(dpat(:, jat), dpat(:, iat))
791	         dpiv = dot_product(dpat(:, iat), vec)
792	         dpjv = dot_product(dpat(:, jat), vec)
793	         edd = dpidpj*r2 - 3*dpjv*dpiv
794	         fddr = 3.0_wp*edd*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*(fdmp5/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
795	         dg(:) = - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*dpidpj*vec &
796	            & + 3.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*dpat(:, jat) + dpjv*dpat(:, iat)) &
797	            & - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec
798	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dg, 2, 3) &
799	            & + spread(dg, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
800	
801	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
802	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
803	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dg
804	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dg
805	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + ds
806	
807	         eq = &
808	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(2,iat) + qpat(2,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(2) &
809	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(4,iat) + qpat(4,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(3) &
810	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(5,iat) + qpat(5,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(3) &
811	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(1,iat) + qpat(1,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(1) &
812	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(3,iat) + qpat(3,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(2) &
813	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(6,iat) + qpat(6,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(3)*vec(3)
814	
815	         fddr = eq * 3.0_wp*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*fdmp5/rr*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
816	         dg(:) = - eq*ddmp5*g7*vec &
817	            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(iat) * &
818	            &[vec(1)*qpat(1,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(2,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(4,jat), &
819	            & vec(1)*qpat(2,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(3,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(5,jat), &
820	            & vec(1)*qpat(4,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,jat)] &
821	            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(jat) * &
822	            &[vec(1)*qpat(1,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(4,iat), &
823	            & vec(1)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(3,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(5,iat), &
824	            & vec(1)*qpat(4,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,iat)]
825	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dG, 2, 3) &
826	            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
827	
828	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
829	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
830	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dg
831	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dg
832	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + ds
833	      end do
834	   end do
835	end subroutine get_multipole_gradient_0d

839	      & dEdr, gradient, sigma)

875	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
876	   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)

884	            vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat) + wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
885	            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
886	
887	            call get_damat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(jat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, jat), &
888	               & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, jat), vol, alpha, rtrans, dGr, dSr)
889	            call get_damat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(jat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, jat), &
890	               & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, jat), rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, dEd, dGd, dSd)
891	            dE = dE + dEd * wsw
892	            dG = dG + (dGd + dGr) * wsw
893	            dS = dS + (dSd + dSr) * wsw

895	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + dE
896	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + dE
897	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dG
898	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dG

from tblite.ase import TBLite  # noqa: E402

symbols = "C2N2O4"
positions = np.asarray(
    [
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        [1.45, 0.0, 0.0],
        [2.50, 0.80, 0.0],
        [2.50, -0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, 0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, -0.80, 0.0],
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.20],
        [1.45, 0.0, 1.20],
    ]
)
cell = np.diag([8.0, 8.0, 8.0])

unit = Atoms(symbols, positions=positions, cell=cell, pbc=True)
unit.calc = TBLite(method="GFN2-xTB", accuracy=0.1, verbosity=0)
e_unit = unit.get_potential_energy()
ea_unit = unit.get_potential_energies()
q_unit = unit.get_charges()

sup = unit.repeat((2, 2, 2))
sup.calc = TBLite(method="GFN2-xTB", accuracy=0.1, verbosity=0)
e_sup = sup.get_potential_energy()
ea_sup = sup.get_potential_energies()
q_sup = sup.get_charges()

# ASE repeat: atom i of replica r at index i * 8 + ... actually first block = original order
ea_sup_blocks = ea_sup.reshape(8, 8)  # replica-major? check ase convention
print("unit per-atom energies :", np.array2string(ea_unit, precision=8))
print("charges unit:", np.array2string(q_unit, precision=8))
print("charge spread over replicas (max-min per atom):")
qs = q_sup.reshape(8, 8)
print(np.array2string(sup.get_charges(), precision=8))
print("replica-brokedown of per-atom energies (replica-major if correct):")
print(np.array2string(ea_sup_blocks, precision=6))
print("mean of replica per-atom vs unit:")
mean_rep = ea_sup_blocks.mean(axis=1)
print(np.array2string(mean_rep - ea_unit, precision=6))

37	subroutine get_mulliken_shell_charges(bas, smat, pmat, n0sh, qsh)
38	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
39	   real(wp), intent(in) :: smat(:, :)
40	   real(wp), intent(in) :: pmat(:, :, :)
41	   real(wp), intent(in) :: n0sh(:)
42	   real(wp), intent(out) :: qsh(:, :)
43	
44	   integer :: ish, ii, iao, jao, spin
45	   real(wp) :: psh
46	
47	   qsh(:, :) = 0.0_wp
48	   !$omp parallel do default(none) collapse(2) schedule(runtime) &
49	   !$omp shared(qsh, bas, pmat, smat) private(spin, ish, ii, iao, jao, psh)
50	   do spin = 1, size(pmat, 3)
51	      do ish = 1, bas%nsh
52	         psh = 0.0_wp
53	         ii = bas%iao_sh(ish)
54	         do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(ish)
55	            do jao = 1, bas%nao
56	               psh = psh + pmat(jao, ii+iao, spin) * smat(jao, ii+iao)
57	            end do
58	         end do
59	         qsh(ish, spin) = -psh
60	      end do
61	   end do
62	
63	   call updown_to_magnet(qsh)
64	   qsh(:, 1) = qsh(:, 1) + n0sh
65

72	   real(wp), intent(in) :: pmat(:, :, :)

132	subroutine get_molecular_dipole_moment(mol, qat, dpat, dpmom)
133	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
134	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qat(:)
135	   real(wp), intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
136	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dpmom(:)
137	
138	   integer :: iat
139	
140	   dpmom(:) = 0.0_wp
141	   do iat = 1, mol%nat

146	subroutine get_molecular_quadrupole_moment(mol, qat, dpat, qpat, qpmom)
147	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
148	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qat(:)
149	   real(wp), intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
150	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
151	   real(wp), intent(out) :: qpmom(:)
152	
153	   integer :: iat
154	   real(wp) :: vec(3), cart(6), tr
155	
156	   qpmom(:) = 0.0_wp
157	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
158	      vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat)*qat(iat)
159	      cart([1, 3, 6]) = mol%xyz(:, iat) * (vec + 2*dpat(:, iat))
160	      cart(2) = mol%xyz(1, iat) * (vec(2) + dpat(2, iat)) + dpat(1, iat)*mol%xyz(2, iat)
161	      cart(4) = mol%xyz(1, iat) * (vec(3) + dpat(3, iat)) + dpat(1, iat)*mol%xyz(3, iat)
162	      cart(5) = mol%xyz(2, iat) * (vec(3) + dpat(3, iat)) + dpat(2, iat)*mol%xyz(3, iat)
163	      tr = 0.5_wp * (cart(1) + cart(3) + cart(6))
164	      cart(1) = 1.5_wp * cart(1) - tr
165	      cart(2) = 3.0_wp * cart(2)
166	      cart(3) = 1.5_wp * cart(3) - tr
167	      cart(4) = 3.0_wp * cart(4)
168	      cart(5) = 3.0_wp * cart(5)
169	      cart(6) = 1.5_wp * cart(6) - tr
170	      qpmom(:) = qpmom(:) + qpat(:, iat) + cart
171	   end do
172	end subroutine get_molecular_quadrupole_moment

175	!> Evaluate Wiberg/Mayer bond orders including factor 2 scaling for open-shell cases
176	subroutine get_mayer_bond_orders(mol, bas, smat, pmat, mbo)
177	   !> Molecular structure data
178	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
179	   !> Basis set information
180	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
181	   !> Overlap matrix
182	   real(wp), intent(in) :: smat(:, :)
183	   !> Density matrix
184	   real(wp), intent(in) :: pmat(:, :, :)
185	   !> Wiberg/Mayer bond orders
186	   real(wp), intent(out) :: mbo(:, :, :)
187	
188	   integer :: iao, jao, iat, jat, ish, jsh, ii, jj, is, js, spin, nspin
189	   real(wp) :: pao, uhf_scale
190	   real(wp), allocatable :: psmat(:, :)
191	
192	   allocate(psmat(bas%nao, bas%nao))
193	
194	   nspin = size(pmat, 3)
195	
196	   ! Scaling factor of 2 for unrestricted case
197	   uhf_scale = 1.0_wp
198	   if (nspin == 2) then
199	      uhf_scale = 2.0_wp
200	   end if
201	
202	   mbo(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
203	   do spin = 1, nspin
204	      call gemm(pmat(:, :, spin), smat, psmat)
205	      !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
206	      !$omp shared(mol, bas, psmat, mbo, spin, uhf_scale) &
207	      !$omp private(iat, jat, is, js, ish, jsh, ii, jj, iao, jao, pao)
208	      do iat = 1, mol%nat
209	         is = bas%ish_at(iat)
210	         do jat = 1, iat - 1
211	            pao = 0.0_wp
212	            js = bas%ish_at(jat)
213	            do ish = 1, bas%nsh_at(iat)
214	            ii = bas%iao_sh(is + ish)
215	               do jsh = 1, bas%nsh_at(jat)
216	                  jj = bas%iao_sh(js + jsh)
217	                  do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(is + ish)
218	                     do jao = 1, bas%nao_sh(js + jsh)
219	                        pao = pao + psmat(jj+jao, ii+iao) * psmat(ii+iao, jj+jao)
220	                     end do
221	                  end do
222	               end do
223	            end do 
224	            mbo(jat, iat, spin) = pao * uhf_scale
225	            mbo(iat, jat, spin) = pao * uhf_scale
226	         end do
227	      end do
228	   end do
229	
230	   call updown_to_magnet(mbo)
231	
232	end subroutine get_mayer_bond_orders
233	
234	
235	end module tblite_wavefunction_mulliken

18	!> Defines a container for holding density dependent potentials
19	
20	!> Implementation of the density dependent potential and its contribution
21	!> to the effective Hamiltonian
22	module tblite_scf_potential
23	   use mctc_env, only : wp
24	   use mctc_io, only : structure_type
25	   use tblite_basis_type, only : basis_type
26	   use tblite_integral_type, only : integral_type
27	   use tblite_wavefunction_spin, only : magnet_to_updown
28	   implicit none
29	   private
30	
31	   public :: new_potential, add_pot_to_h1
32	
33	
34	   !> Container for density dependent potential-shifts
35	   type, public :: potential_type
36	      !> Flag if potential includes potential gradients 
37	      logical :: grad = .false.
38	      !> Atom-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
39	      real(wp), allocatable :: vat(:, :)
40	      !> Shell-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
41	      real(wp), allocatable :: vsh(:, :)
42	      !> Orbital-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
43	      real(wp), allocatable :: vao(:, :)
44	
45	      !> Atom-resolved dipolar potential
46	      real(wp), allocatable :: vdp(:, :, :)
47	      !> Atom-resolved quadrupolar potential
48	      real(wp), allocatable :: vqp(:, :, :)
49	
50	      !> Position derivative of atom-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
51	      real(wp), allocatable :: dvatdr(:, :, :, :)
52	      !> Lattice vector derivative of atom-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
53	      real(wp), allocatable :: dvatdL(:, :, :, :)
54	
55	      !> Position derivative of shell-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
56	      real(wp), allocatable :: dvshdr(:, :, :, :)
57	      !> Lattice vector derivative of shell-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
58	      real(wp), allocatable :: dvshdL(:, :, :, :)
59	   contains
60	      !> Reset the density dependent potential
61	      procedure :: reset
62	   end type potential_type
63	
64	
65	contains
66	
67	
68	!> Create a new potential object
69	subroutine new_potential(self, mol, bas, nspin, grad)
70	   !> Instance of the density dependent potential
71	   type(potential_type), intent(out) :: self
72	   !> Molecular structure data
73	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
74	   !> Description of the basis set
75	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
76	   !> Number of spin channels
77	   integer, intent(in) :: nspin
78	   !> Flag to indicate if potential gradients are requested
79	   logical, intent(in), optional :: grad
80	
81	   allocate(self%vat(mol%nat, nspin))
82	   allocate(self%vsh(bas%nsh, nspin))
83	   allocate(self%vao(bas%nao, nspin))
84	
85	   allocate(self%vdp(3, mol%nat, nspin))
86	   allocate(self%vqp(6, mol%nat, nspin))
87	
88	   if(present(grad)) then
89	      if(grad) then
90	         self%grad = .true.
91	         allocate(self%dvatdr(3, mol%nat, mol%nat, nspin))
92	         allocate(self%dvatdL(3, 3, mol%nat, nspin))
93	
94	         allocate(self%dvshdr(3, mol%nat, bas%nsh, nspin))
95	         allocate(self%dvshdL(3, 3, bas%nsh, nspin))
96	      end if
97	   end if
98	
99	end subroutine new_potential

101	!> Reset the density dependent potential
102	subroutine reset(self)
103	   !> Instance of the density dependent potential
104	   class(potential_type), intent(inout) :: self
105	
106	   self%vat(:, :) = 0.0_wp

112	   if(self%grad) then
113	      self%dvatdr(:, :, :, :) = 0.0_wp

117	      self%dvshdL(:, :, :, :) = 0.0_wp
118	   end if
119	end subroutine reset

121	!> Add the collected potential shifts to the effective Hamiltonian
122	subroutine add_pot_to_h1(bas, ints, pot, h1)
123	   !> Basis set information
124	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
125	   !> Integral container
126	   type(integral_type), intent(in) :: ints
127	   !> Density dependent potential-shifts
128	   type(potential_type), intent(inout) :: pot
129	   !> Effective Hamiltonian
130	   real(wp), intent(out) :: h1(:, :, :)
131	
132	   h1(:, :, 1) = ints%hamiltonian
133	   if (size(h1, 3) > 1) h1(:, :, 2:) = 0.0_wp
134	
135	   call add_vat_to_vsh(bas, pot%vat, pot%vsh)
136	   call add_vsh_to_vao(bas, pot%vsh, pot%vao)
137	   call add_vao_to_h1(bas, ints%overlap, pot%vao, h1)
138	   call add_vmp_to_h1(bas, ints%dipole, pot%vdp, h1)
139	   call add_vmp_to_h1(bas, ints%quadrupole, pot%vqp, h1)
140	
141	   call magnet_to_updown(h1)
142	end subroutine add_pot_to_h1

144	!> Expand an atom-resolved potential shift to a shell-resolved potential shift
145	subroutine add_vat_to_vsh(bas, vat, vsh)
146	   !> Basis set information
147	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
148	   !> Atom-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
149	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vat(:, :)
150	   !> Shell-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
151	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: vsh(:, :)
152	
153	   integer :: iat, ish, ii, spin
154	
155	   !$omp parallel do schedule(runtime) collapse(2) default(none) &
156	   !$omp shared(bas, vat, vsh) private(spin, ii, ish, iat)
157	   do spin = 1, size(vat, 2)
158	      do iat = 1, size(vat, 1)
159	         ii = bas%ish_at(iat)
160	         do ish = 1, bas%nsh_at(iat)
161	            vsh(ii+ish, spin) = vsh(ii+ish, spin) + vat(iat, spin)
162	         end do
163	      end do
164	   end do
165	end subroutine add_vat_to_vsh
166	
167	!> Expand a shell-resolved potential shift to an orbital-resolved potential shift
168	subroutine add_vsh_to_vao(bas, vsh, vao)
169	   !> Basis set information
170	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
171	   !> Shell-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
172	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vsh(:, :)
173	   !> Orbital-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
174	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: vao(:, :)
175	
176	   integer :: ish, iao, ii, spin
177	
178	   !$omp parallel do schedule(runtime) collapse(2) default(none) &
179	   !$omp shared(bas, vsh, vao) private(ii, iao, ish)
180	   do spin = 1, size(vsh, 2)
181	      do ish = 1, size(vsh, 1)
182	         ii = bas%iao_sh(ish)
183	         do iao = 1, bas%nao_sh(ish)
184	            vao(ii+iao, spin) = vao(ii+iao, spin) + vsh(ish, spin)
185	         end do
186	      end do
187	   end do
188	end subroutine add_vsh_to_vao
189	
190	
191	!> Add a charge-dependent potential to the Hamiltonian
192	subroutine add_vao_to_h1(bas, sint, vao, h1)
193	   !> Basis set information
194	   type(basis_type), intent(in) :: bas
195	   !> Overlap integrals
196	   real(wp), intent(in) :: sint(:, :)
197	   !> Orbital-resolved charge-dependent potential shift
198	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vao(:, :)
199	   !> Effective Hamiltonian
200	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: h1(:, :, :)
201	
202	   integer :: iao, jao, spin, nao
203	   real(wp) :: vij
204	
205	   nao = bas%nao
206	
207	   !$omp parallel do collapse(2) schedule(runtime) default(none) &
208	   !$omp shared(h1, sint, vao, nao) private(spin, iao, jao, vij)
209	   do spin = 1, size(h1, 3)
210	      do iao = 1, nao
211	         do jao = 1, iao
212	            vij = -sint(jao, iao) * 0.5_wp * (vao(jao, spin) + vao(iao, spin))
213	            h1(jao, iao, spin) = h1(jao, iao, spin) + vij
214	            if (jao /= iao) then
215	               h1(iao, jao, spin) = h1(iao, jao, spin) + vij
216	            end if
217	         end do
218	      end do
219	   end do

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path("/workspace/task")
SOURCE_ROOT = TASK_ROOT / "source"
BUILD_ROOT = TASK_ROOT / ".build"

library = next(c for c in sorted(BUILD_ROOT.glob("libtblite*.so*")) if c.is_file())
ctypes.CDLL(str(library), mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
ext = next(BUILD_ROOT.glob("python/tblite/_libtblite*.so"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT / "python"))
import tblite  # noqa: E402

tblite.__path__.insert(0, str(ext.parent))
from ase import Atoms  # noqa: E402
from tblite.interface import Calculator  # noqa: E402
from tblite.interface import symbols_to_numbers

symbols = "C2N2O4"
positions = np.asarray(
    [
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        [1.45, 0.0, 0.0],
        [2.50, 0.80, 0.0],
        [2.50, -0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, 0.80, 0.0],
        [-1.00, -0.80, 0.0],
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.20],
        [1.45, 0.0, 1.20],
    ]
)
Bohr = 0.529177210544
cell = np.diag([8.0, 8.0, 8.0])


def run(rep):
    atoms = Atoms(symbols, positions=positions, cell=cell, pbc=True).repeat(rep)
    calc = Calculator(
        "GFN2-xTB",
        symbols_to_numbers(list(atoms.symbols)),
        atoms.positions / Bohr,
        lattice=atoms.cell.array.reshape(-1) / Bohr,
        periodic=atoms.pbc,
        verbosity=0,
    )
    calc.set("accuracy", 0.1)
    res = calc.singlepoint()
    return atoms, calc, res


for rep, tag in [((1, 1, 1), "unit"), ((2, 2, 2), "sup222")]:
    atoms, calc, res = run(rep)
    f = f"/tmp/wfn_{tag}.npz"
    res.save(f)
    data = np.load(f)
    print(tag, "keys:", sorted(data.files))
    print(tag, "energy:", res["energy"] * 27.21138620098853)
    np.savez(
        f"/tmp/moments_{tag}.npz",
        positions=atoms.positions,
        cell=atoms.cell.array,
        qat=data["wfn/qat"].copy(),
        dpat=data["wfn/dpat"].copy(),
        qpat=data["wfn/qpat"].copy(),
    )

"""Reference multipole electrostatics: direct lattice sums, matching tblite's
get_multipole_matrix/get_energy contract (all ordered pairs, gemv semantics).

Units: positions/lattice in bohr, q in e, d in e*bohr, theta in e*bohr^2 -> energies in Eh.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from scipy.special import erf, erfc  # noqa: F401  (not needed for direct sums)

BOHR = 0.529177210544

# model data
p_rad = {
    6: 3.0, 7: 1.9, 8: 1.8,
}
kdmp3, kdmp5 = 3.0, 4.0
rmax = 5.0
mp_shift, mp_kexp = 1.2, 4.0


def mrad_for(z, cn_guess=None):
    # approximate: cn ~ vcn radii baseline (logistic correction is small)
    rad = p_rad[z]
    vcn = {6: 3.0, 7: 3.0, 8: 2.0}[z]
    cn = vcn if cn_guess is None else cn_guess
    arg = cn - vcn - mp_shift
    return rad + (rmax - rad) / (1.0 + np.exp(-mp_kexp * arg))


def images(lattice, rmax_abs):
    a = np.linalg.norm(lattice, axis=1)
    reps = [int(np.ceil(rmax_abs / x)) for x in a]
    out = []
    for i in range(-reps[0], reps[0] + 1):
        for j in range(-reps[1], reps[1] + 1):
            for k in range(-reps[2], reps[2] + 1):
                out.append(i * lattice[0] + j * lattice[1] + k * lattice[2])
    return np.asarray(out)


def channel_energies(pos, lattice, zs, q, d, th, eval_images):
    """Evaluate sd/dd/sq electrostatic energies by direct lattice summation."""
    nat = len(q)
    rr = np.asarray([mrad_for(z) for z in zs])
    E_sd = 0.0
    E_dd = 0.0
    E_sq = 0.0
    for iat in range(nat):
        for jat in range(nat):
            rr_ij = 0.5 * (rr[iat] + rr[jat])
            # all images of jat
            rel = pos[iat] - pos[jat] - eval_images  # (Nimg, 3)
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(rel, axis=1)
            inside = r1 > 1e-8
            rel = rel[inside]
            r1 = r1[inside]
            g1 = 1.0 / r1
            g3 = g1**3
            g5 = g3 * g1**2
            fdmp3 = 1.0 / (1.0 + 6.0 * (rr_ij * g1) ** kdmp3)
            fdmp5 = 1.0 / (1.0 + 6.0 * (rr_ij * g1) ** kdmp5)

            # sd: d_i . (r f3 g3) q_j
            E_sd += np.sum((rel * fdmp3 * g3) @ d[iat,:]) * q[jat]

            # dd: 0.5 [ (d_i.d_j)(fdmp5 g3) - 3 (d_i.r)(d_j.r) fdmp5 g5 ]
            di = d[iat,:, None]  # (3,1)
            djR = (rel * d[jat]).sum(axis=1)  # d_j . r
            diR = rel @ d[iat]
            E_dd += 0.5 * np.sum((d[iat] @ d[jat]) * fdmp5 * g3 - 3.0 * diR * djR * fdmp5 * g5)

            # sq: theta_i . K(r) q_j
            x, y, z = rel[:, 0], rel[:, 1], rel[:, 2]
            t = th[iat]
            # traceless theta: [xx,xy,yy,xz,yz,zz]
            csq = (fdmp5 * g3) / 3.0
            val = (
                (x * x * g5 * fdmp5 - csq) * t[0]
                + (2 * x * y * g5 * fdmp5) * t[1]
                + (y * y * g5 * fdmp5 - csq) * t[2]
                + (2 * x * z * g5 * fdmp5) * t[3]
                + (2 * y * z * g5 * fdmp5) * t[4]
                + (z * z * g5 * fdmp5 - csq) * t[5]
            )
            E_sq += np.sum(val) * q[jat]
    return E_sd, E_dd, E_sq


def replicate(pos, lattice, q, d, th, zs, rep):
    n1, n2, n3 = rep
    ncell = n1 * n2 * n3
    nat = len(q)
    pbig = np.zeros((ncell * nat, 3))
    qbig = np.tile(q, ncell)
    dbig = np.tile(d, (ncell, 1))
    tbig = np.tile(th, (ncell, 1))
    zbig = np.tile(zs, ncell)
    n = 0
    for i in range(n1):
        for j in range(n2):
            for k in range(n3):
                shift = i * lattice[0] + j * lattice[1] + k * lattice[2]
                pbig[n * nat : (n + 1) * nat] = pos + shift
                n += 1
    lbig = lattice.copy()
    lbig[0] *= n1
    lbig[1] *= n2
    lbig[2] *= n3
    return pbig, lbig, zbig, qbig, dbig, tbig


def main():
    m = np.load("/tmp/moments_unit.npz")
    positions_a = m["positions"] / BOHR
    cell_a = m["cell"] / BOHR
    q = m["qat"][:, 0]
    d = m["dpat"][:, :, 0].T  # (nat, 3)
    th = m["qpat"][:, :, 0].T  # (nat, 6)? check shape
    # dpat stored as (3, nat) per restart; check:
    print("dpat shape in npz:", m["dpat"].shape, "qpat:", m["qpat"].shape)
    zs = np.array([6, 6, 7, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8])

    # direct sum cutoffs: moderately large to see convergence
    for cutoff in (40.0, 60.0):
        img = images(cell_a, cutoff)
        # drop images farther than cutoff from origin to keep a spherical-ish sum
        norm = np.linalg.norm(img, axis=1)
        img = img[norm <= cutoff * 1.0001]
        E1 = channel_energies(positions_a, cell_a, zs, q, d, th, img)
        p2, l2, z2, q2, d2, t2 = replicate(positions_a, cell_a, q, d, th, zs, (2, 2, 2))
        img2 = images(l2, cutoff)
        norm = np.linalg.norm(img2, axis=1)
        img2 = img2[norm <= cutoff * 1.0001]
        E2 = channel_energies(p2, l2, z2, q2, d2, t2, img2)
        e2per = np.asarray(E2) / 8.0
        print(f"cutoff {cutoff} bohr  (nimg={len(img)}/{len(img2)})")
        print(f"  sd  unit={E1[0]:+.8f}  222/8={e2per[0]:+.8f}  diff={e2per[0]-E1[0]:+.3e}")
        print(f"  dd  unit={E1[1]:+.8f}  222/8={e2per[1]:+.8f}  diff={e2per[1]-E1[1]:+.3e}")
        print(f"  sq  unit={E1[2]:+.8f}  222/8={e2per[2]:+.8f}  diff={e2per[2]-E1[2]:+.3e}")
        print(f"  tot unit={sum(E1):+.8f}  222/8={sum(e2per):+.8f}  diff={sum(e2per)-sum(E1):+.3e}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Python replication of tblite's get_multipole_matrix_3d Ewald scheme.

Evaluate the three channel energies E_sd / E_dd / E_sq at fixed multipoles for
both the unit cell and replicated supercells, following the Fortran formulas
line by line (dir + rec + self + G0 terms).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from scipy.special import erf, erfc

BOHR = 0.529177210544

p_rad = {6: 3.0, 7: 1.9, 8: 1.8}
p_vcn = {6: 3.0, 7: 3.0, 8: 2.0}
kdmp3, kdmp5 = 3.0, 4.0
rmax = 5.0
mp_shift, mp_kexp = 1.2, 4.0

EPS = np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps)
CONV = 100.0 * EPS
SQRTPI = np.sqrt(np.pi)


def mrad_for(z):
    rad = p_rad[z]
    vcn = p_vcn[z]
    arg = vcn - vcn - mp_shift  # assume cn ~ vcn (small correction)
    return rad + (rmax - rad) / (1.0 + np.exp(-mp_kexp * arg))


# ---------- Ewald machinery (ewald.f90) ----------


def rec_3d_value(d, alpha, vol):
    return 4 * np.pi * np.exp(-0.25 * d * d / alpha**2) / (vol * d * d)


def dir_value(d, alpha):
    return erfc(alpha * d) / d


def rec_3d_mp_value(d, alpha, vol):
    return 4 * np.pi * np.exp(-0.25 * d * d / alpha**2) / vol


def dir_mp_value(d, alpha):
    arg = alpha * d
    return (2 / SQRTPI * arg * np.exp(-arg * arg) + erfc(arg)) / d**3


def rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp=False):
    if mp:
        recv = lambda d: rec_3d_mp_value(d, alpha, vol)
        dirv = lambda d: dir_mp_value(d, alpha)
    else:
        recv = lambda d: rec_3d_value(d, alpha, vol)
        dirv = lambda d: dir_value(d, alpha)
    return (recv(4 * rlen) - recv(5 * rlen)) - (dirv(2 * dlen) - dirv(3 * dlen))


def get_alpha(lattice, mp=False):
    vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
    rec_lat = 2 * np.pi * np.linalg.inv(lattice).T
    rlen = np.sqrt(np.min((rec_lat**2).sum(axis=0)))
    dlen = np.sqrt(np.min((lattice**2).sum(axis=0)))
    alpha0 = np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps)
    tolerance = EPS
    alpha = alpha0
    diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp)
    stat = 0
    niter = 30
    while diff < -tolerance and alpha <= np.finfo(float).max:
        alpha = 2.0 * alpha
        diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp)
    if alpha > np.finfo(float).max:
        stat = 1
    elif alpha == alpha0:
        stat = 2
    if stat == 0:
        alpl = 0.5 * alpha
        while diff < tolerance and alpha <= np.finfo(float).max:
            alpha = 2.0 * alpha
            diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp)
        if alpha > np.finfo(float).max:
            stat = 3
    if stat == 0:
        alpr = alpha
        alpha = (alpl + alpr) * 0.5
        ibs = 0
        diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp)
        while abs(diff) > tolerance and ibs <= niter:
            if diff < 0:
                alpl = alpha
            else:
                alpr = alpha
            alpha = (alpl + alpr) * 0.5
            diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, rlen, dlen, vol, mp)
            ibs += 1
        if ibs > niter:
            stat = 4
    if stat != 0:
        alpha = 0.25
    return alpha


def search_cutoff(get_value, alpha, volume, conv):
    miter = 30
    x = np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps)
    y = get_value(x, alpha, volume)
    while y > conv and x <= np.finfo(float).max:
        x = 2.0 * x
        y = get_value(x, alpha, volume)
    xl = 0.5 * x
    yl = get_value(xl, alpha, volume)
    xr = x
    yr = y
    for _ in range(miter):
        if yl - yr <= conv:
            break
        x = 0.5 * (xl + xr)
        y = get_value(x, alpha, volume)
        if y >= conv:
            xl, yl = x, y
        else:
            xr, yr = x, y
    return x


def cube_lattice_points(lattice, rthr):
    a = np.linalg.norm(lattice, axis=1)
    reps = [int(np.ceil(rthr / x)) for x in a]
    lat = lattice
    out = []
    for ix in range(-reps[0], reps[0] + 1):
        for iy in range(-reps[1], reps[1] + 1):
            for iz in range(-reps[2], reps[2] + 1):
                out.append(ix * lat[0] + iy * lat[1] + iz * lat[2])
    return np.asarray(out)


def channel_matrices_ewald(pos, lattice, zs, alpha=None, use_mp_alpha=False):
    nat = len(zs)
    vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
    if alpha is None:
        alpha = get_alpha(lattice, mp=use_mp_alpha)
    dcut = search_cutoff(lambda d, a, v: dir_value(d, a), alpha, vol, CONV)
    rcut = search_cutoff(lambda d, a, v: rec_3d_value(d, a, v), alpha, vol, CONV)
    dtrans = cube_lattice_points(lattice, np.linalg.norm(lattice, axis=1) * 0 + dcut)
    rec_lat = 2 * np.pi * np.linalg.inv(lattice).T
    rtrans = cube_lattice_points(rec_lat, rcut)
    rtrans = rtrans[(rtrans**2).sum(axis=1) > EPS]

    rr = np.asarray([mrad_for(z) for z in zs])
    A_sd = np.zeros((3, nat, nat))
    A_dd = np.zeros((3, nat, 3, nat))
    A_sq = np.zeros((6, nat, nat))

    unity = np.eye(3)
    fac = 4 * np.pi / vol
    # G=0 terms (per pair)
    g0_dd = fac / 6.0 * unity
    g0_sq = np.array([-fac / 9.0, 0.0, -fac / 9.0, 0.0, 0.0, -fac / 9.0])

    for iat in range(nat):
        for jat in range(nat):
            rr_ij = 0.5 * (rr[iat] + rr[jat])
            rij = pos[iat] - pos[jat]
            # dir part
            for t in dtrans:
                vec = rij + t
                r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
                if r1 < EPS:
                    continue
                g1 = 1.0 / r1
                g3 = g1**3
                g5 = g3 * g1**2
                fdmp3 = 1.0 / (1.0 + 6.0 * (rr_ij * g1) ** kdmp3)
                fdmp5 = 1.0 / (1.0 + 6.0 * (rr_ij * g1) ** kdmp5)
                arg = r1 * alpha
                erft = -erf(arg) * g1
                expt = np.exp(-(arg**2)) / SQRTPI
                e1 = g1 * g1 * (erft + 2 * expt * alpha)
                e2 = g1 * g1 * (e1 + 4 * expt * alpha**3 / 3.0)
                A_sd[:, iat, jat] += vec * (fdmp3 * g3 + e1)
                A_dd[:, iat, :, jat] += unity * (fdmp5 * g3 + e1) - 3.0 * np.outer(vec, vec) * (
                    g5 * fdmp5 + e2
                )
                vv = vec
                c5 = g5 * fdmp5 + e2
                c3 = (fdmp5 * g3 + e1) / 3.0
                A_sq[:, iat, jat] += [
                    vv[0] ** 2 * c5 - c3,
                    2 * vv[0] * vv[1] * c5,
                    vv[1] ** 2 * c5 - c3,
                    2 * vv[0] * vv[2] * c5,
                    2 * vv[1] * vv[2] * c5,
                    vv[2] ** 2 * c5 - c3,
                ]
            # rec part
            for gvec in rtrans:
                g2 = gvec @ gvec
                gv = rij @ gvec
                expk = fac * np.exp(-0.25 * g2 / alpha**2) / g2
                sink = np.sin(gv) * expk
                cosk = np.cos(gv) * expk
                A_sd[:, iat, jat] += 2 * gvec * sink
                A_dd[:, iat, :, jat] += np.outer(gvec, gvec) * cosk
                A_sq[:, iat, jat] += [
                    gvec[0] ** 2 * cosk,
                    2 * gvec[0] * gvec[1] * cosk,
                    gvec[1] ** 2 * cosk,
                    2 * gvec[0] * gvec[2] * cosk,
                    2 * gvec[1] * gvec[2] * cosk,
                    gvec[2] ** 2 * cosk,
                ]
            # G=0 terms
            A_dd[:, iat, :, jat] += g0_dd
            A_sq[:, iat, jat] += g0_sq

    # self terms
    rrd = -2.0 / 3.0 * alpha**3 / SQRTPI
    for iat in range(nat):
        for k in range(3):
            A_dd[k, iat, k, iat] += 2 * rrd
    rrq = 4.0 / 9.0 * alpha**3 / SQRTPI
    for iat in range(nat):
        A_sq[[0, 2, 5], iat, iat] += rrq

    return A_sd, A_dd, A_sq, alpha, (dcut, rcut)


def energies(pos, q, d, th, A):
    A_sd, A_dd, A_sq = A
    vd = np.einsum("aij,j->ia", A_sd, q) + 0.5 * np.einsum("aibj,jb->ia", A_dd, d)
    vq = np.einsum("aij,j->ia", A_sq, q)
    E_sd = np.sum(einsum := np.einsum("aij,j->ia", A_sd, q) * d)  # d . (A_sd q)
    E_dd = 0.5 * np.sum(np.einsum("aibj,jb->ia", A_dd, d) * d)
    E_sq = np.sum(np.einsum("aij,j->ia", A_sq, q) * th)
    return E_sd, E_dd, E_sq, 0.0


def replicate(pos, lattice, q, d, th, zs, rep):
    n1, n2, n3 = rep
    ncell = n1 * n2 * n3
    nat = len(q)
    pbig = np.zeros((ncell * nat, 3))
    for n, (i, j, k) in enumerate(
        [(i, j, k) for i in range(n1) for j in range(n2) for k in range(n3)]
    ):
        shift = i * lattice[0] + j * lattice[1] + k * lattice[2]
        pbig[n * nat : (n + 1) * nat] = pos + shift
    lbig = lattice * np.array([[n1], [n2], [n3]])
    return pbig, lbig, np.tile(zs, ncell), np.tile(q, ncell), np.tile(d, (ncell, 1)), np.tile(th, (ncell, 1))


def main():
    m = np.load("/tmp/moments_unit.npz")
    pos = m["positions"] / BOHR
    cell = m["cell"] / BOHR
    q = m["qat"][:, 0]
    d = m["dpat"][:, :, 0].T
    th = m["qpat"][:, :, 0].T
    zs = np.array([6, 6, 7, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8])

    for label, kwa in (("mp_alpha=.false.", dict(use_mp_alpha=False)),):
        print(label)
        A1 = channel_matrices_ewald(pos, cell, zs, **kwa)
        print(f"  unit alpha={A1[3]:.6f} cut d/r={A1[4][0]:.2f}/{A1[4][1]:.2f}")
        E1 = energies(pos, q, d, th, A1[:3])
        p2, l2, z2, q2, d2, t2 = replicate(pos, cell, q, d, th, zs, (2, 2, 2))
        A2 = channel_matrices_ewald(p2, l2, z2, **kwa)
        print(f"  222  alpha={A2[3]:.6f} cut d/r={A2[4][0]:.2f}/{A2[4][1]:.2f}")
        E2 = energies(p2, q2, d2, t2, A2[:3])
        e2per = np.asarray(E2[:3]) / 8.0
        for name, a, b in zip("sd dd sq".split(), E1, e2per):
            print(f"  {name}: unit={a:+.10f}  222/8={b:+.10f}  diff={b - a:+.3e}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
